spriteComponent.name: BackgroundSprite
spriteComponent.event:
component("spriteName"):SetString("$backgroundSpriteName")
local layer = "$layer" if element:HasVar("layer") then layer = element("layer"):GetString() end component("layer"):SetString(layer)

spriteSheetComponent.name: Icon
spriteSheetComponent.event:
component("spriteName"):SetString("PlayerLevel_Star") component("sheetName"):SetString("xml_resources/hud03.xml") component("size"):SetFloat(0.25*$scale)
local layer = "$layer" if element:HasVar("layer") then layer = element("layer"):GetString() end component("layer"):SetString(layer)

textComponent.name: Text
textComponent.event:
component("multiline"):SetInt(0) component("font"):Set(game.getTutorialFont()) component("size"):SetFloat(0.2*$scale) component("alignment"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuTextComponent_TEXT_HCENTER_ALIGNED) component("text"):SetString("99") component("autoScale"):SetInt(1)
local palette = include("ColourPalette") component:setColor(palette:getRGBFloats(palette.XP_STAR_LEVEL_HUD))
local layer = "$layer" if element:HasVar("layer") then layer = element("layer"):GetString() end component("layer"):SetString(layer)
